title: Established Psychometric vs. Ecologically Valid Questionnaires: Rethinking Psychological Assessments in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper assesses LLMs using the Portrait Values Questionnaire (PVQ), which evaluates human value systems (e.g., tradition, benevolence, universalism). Furthermore, it specifically benchmarks model responses using religious demographic personas ('religious vs. non-religious') to analyze bias and score differences.
